en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Sama’at who said,
‘Heasws was asked about the prisoner of the Polytheists. So the Salāt (time) comes up, but the one who imprisoned him prevents him from it. Heasws said: ‘He would indicate with gestures’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah from Sama‘ah who has said the following: “

He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was asked about the captive of the pagans. It becomes time for Salah (prayer) and the captor does not allow him to perform Salah (prayer). He (the Imam) said, ‘He performs Salah (prayer) by making gestures.’”
